title: Lift an Ice Cube With a Thread #science #physics
description:
Lay a wet thread across an ice cube, sprinkle a pinch of salt on it, and wait a couple of minutes. Then pull: the cube comes up with the thread. No knot, no glue. Salt melts a thin layer of ice, and melting takes heat out of the cube, so it gets colder than zero. The meltwater dilutes the salt, and the cold cube freezes the water around the thread again, with the thread inside. If it does not lift, wait a little longer.
